case_title: THEODORE F. DUBASIK et al VS. RACHELLE M. DENOS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,352.75 FILED BY DUBASIK, THEODORE F. DUBASIK, MELISSA A. AS TO DEFENDANT DENOS, RACHELLE M. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-27-2009 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$80.00) SERVED JAN-16-2009, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT DENOS, RACHELLE M.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-27-2009 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-27-2009 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: QUEENA HO. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF ONLY. PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE JUDGE PRO TEM QUEENA HO FILED BY DUBASIK, THEODORE F. DUBASIK, MELISSA A.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-27-2009 - CONTINUED ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION TO APR-03-2009 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF FAILED TO PROVIDE TO THE COURT A COPY OF THE SALES CONTRACT AND DISLOSURES BETWEEN DUBASIK AND DENOS, AND THUS HAS FAILED TO ESTABLISH WHAT REPRESENTATIONS WERE MADE BY DEFENDANT REGARDING THE DATES OF TENANCY. TRIAL IS CONTINUED TO APRIL 3, 2009 AND PLAINTIFF CAN PRESENT HIS CASE AGAIN, WITH THE REQUIRED INFORMATION/DOCUMENT(S).V PLAINITFF'S EXHIBITS RETAINED IN THE COURT FILE. JUDGE PRO TEM: QUEENA HO. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF APR-03-2009 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF APR-03-2009 BY JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID MCDONALD. APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. EXHIBITS RETAINED. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID MCDONALD FILED BY DUBASIK, THEODORE F. DUBASIK, MELISSA A. DENOS, RACHELLE M.
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-03-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF DUBASIK, THEODORE F. DUBASIK, MELISSA A. IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT DENOS, RACHELLE M. COURT FINDS THAT PLAINTIFFS (1) FAILED TO SHOW DEFENDANT HAD ACTUAL KNOWLEDGE OF THE TERMS OF THE TENANCIES OF THE SUB-TENANTS, (2) COULD HAVE REASONABLY DISCOVERED THE INFORMATION IF THEY HAD ASKED. GOODMAN VS. KENNEDY 18 CAL3D 335 (1976). STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED AUG-03-2009 ORDERED DESTROYED
